qualitative.cfg5_prism_native_negative: Distinct dog and penguin and grounded aircraft recover versus joint-six. Dog hat is conical, penguin is too small and lacks hat, aircraft colors and runway placement remain wrong.
qualitative.cfg5_adapted_native: Similar scene layout to final PRISM; both animals retain blue helmets better. Colors and layout still imperfect.
qualitative.cfg1: PRISM improves over pre-full route and approaches native scene structure, with distorted subjects and missing attributes.
qualitative.prism_negative_cfg5: Untrained empty-chat negative anchor; this is an ablation only.

limitations: Eight held-out captions at three fixed times are 24 paired cases, not 24 independent captions or image accuracy.
Two generation cases are qualitative evidence, not a broad benchmark.
Both connector and DiT changed; longitudinal comparisons do not isolate which component caused improvement.
Training probes differ from earlier subset diagnostics; do not compare their aggregate means longitudinally.
Ordinary sampler attests initial latents and image files, not every sampling forward/final latent.
Training-run wrong-caption gaps retain their original provisional status; this separate diagnostic adds actual noisy-input/timestep controls for its own cases.
next_action: Authorized full-data training and bounded evaluation complete. Stop this follow-up; new training or broader benchmarks require separate user direction.
